archetypes.name: flag-removal-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan removes --manual/manual_gate_b/MANUAL_REQUESTED from 12+ files but test fixture files and harness .md docs outside the explicit file list may still carry these tokens, causing runtime or lint failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan removes the --manual / manual_gate_b / MANUAL_REQUESTED flag surface from a specific list of files. Read each in-scope file from scope-files.txt and check for residual occurrences of manual_gate_b, MANUAL_REQUESTED, --manual-requested, and manual_requested not explicitly covered by the plan's removal steps. Also identify any test fixture files, harness .md docs, or validation-pattern scripts that reference these tokens but are absent from the file list—grep in skills/design/scripts/ and scripts/ for these tokens. Flag every occurrence that the plan does not assign a removal step. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-chain-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces DRIFT_*/BASELINE_* KVs that must traverse an unbroken emission→parse→forward→result-env→consumer chain; any missing link causes drift to silently never fire with no error signal.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan adds DRIFT_* / BASELINE_* KV fields that must flow as a complete chain: emitted by check-plan-size.sh stdout, parsed by parse_kv_from_output arms in design-postplan-emit.sh, forwarded through _postplan_build_kvs defaults, flushed into .design-postplan-emit-result.env, and consumed by case arms in SKILL.md, approval-gates.md, and discussion-rounds.md for both the standalone Step 2b.5 and merged _postplan_finish_merged_plan_size paths. Read the relevant sections of each file and verify the plan explicitly names a concrete code action for every link in this chain. Flag any link described vaguely or whose plan step does not reference the specific function or variable being changed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: loop-collapse-status-mapping
archetypes.rationale: Collapsing plan-review-loop.sh's multi-round body to a single pass requires hoisting all LOOP_STATUS assignments from the old loop body; any missed assignment silently sets LOOP_STATUS=complete on failure paths, defeating the error-handling that callers depend on.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan collapses plan-review-loop.sh's multi-round loop body (approximately lines 1780-1818) to a single-pass exit path and says to hoist post-round status mapping. Read plan-review-loop.sh in that line range and enumerate every distinct LOOP_STATUS assignment present (tally-error, degraded-empty-collector, zero-findings-degraded-panel, panel-failed, main-agent-vote-required, and any others). Then verify that the plan's single-pass description for plan-review-loop.sh explicitly names each of these statuses and the condition that sets it, leaving no path where a failure condition falls through to the default LOOP_STATUS=complete. Also verify the plan accounts for the --round-cap inert-but-accepted semantics so that the ROUND_CAP_ARG_SEEN branch is not inadvertently retained as a bifurcation point. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
